name: Buyer Protection Instruction Allegement Notification V 01
definition: Scope|An account servicer sends a BuyerProtectionInstructionAllegementNotification to an account owner to advise the account owner that a counterparty has alleged a Buyer Protection Instruction against the account owner's account at the account servicer. An action may be required by the account owner.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

CorporateActionGeneralInformation.name: Corporate Action General Information
CorporateActionGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the corporate action event.

RelatedSettlementInstruction.name: Related Settlement Instruction
RelatedSettlementInstruction.definition: Details of the buyer protected settlement instruction.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Selected safekeeping accounts list to which the corporate action event applies.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
